notes: Prospect is a regional consortium managing emergency response and critical comms for three agencies. Heavy regulatory posture.
Primary ask: fully air-gapped Private deployment inside gov datacenter; public internet egress is not permitted. MUST support FIPS-hardened KMS and be able to operate with HSM for key unwrap.
Quote from CTO: 'We cannot tolerate any telemetry leaving our network. Logs only stored locally with retention controls. Need provable chain-of-custody.'
Preferred models: will test quantized Llama-family 70B and a smaller 13B fallback; interested in Redwood performance/quantization profiles and offline verification of weights.

Latency/throughput targets: median token-latency <200ms at 512 tokens for chat flows; sustained throughput ~30 qps for concurrent operator consoles. Cost sensitivity secondary to compliance but want cost/perf knobs.
POC ask: 6-8 week air-gapped POC using customer-provided Rack (8x A100 equivalent), Redwood to supply private control plane appliance (airgap installer) and offline verification checklist.
Security review: needs completed security questionnaire, STIG hardening checklist, and a whitebox FIPS/KMS integration plan. CISO requested runtime SBOM and signed CLA for model provenance.
Ops concerns: network segmentation means no outbound callbacks; any webhook-based plugin or tool-calling must be reworked to run inside their DMZ.
Redwood differentiators that resonated: unified private runtime, ability to pin model versions, deterministic fallback models, and Optimize tool recommendations for quantization profiles.
Budget: expect multi-year reserved capacity procurement; procurement window Q2 2026. Working through contract templates with GC (legal).
Shortcuts/notes from AE: 'focus on STIG doc, provide clear installer runbook, include HSM/KMS integration sample; avoid promises about telemetry until legal signs NDA.'
